findings.title: macOS inclusion assertion passes if the macos job disappears
findings.reason: False positive. The test 'smoke' at test/unit/maintainer-workflows.test.mjs:122-123 already asserts that the ubuntu, macos and windows jobs all exist and that macos runs on macos-latest. Deleting the macos job therefore fails the suite, while the loop at line 28 pins macOS-only inclusion of local-checks.

findings.title: Release-015 baton body still shows the default /ce-work instructions
findings.reason: Bookkeeping only; routing and behavior are unaffected. Routing comes from the frontmatter and `handoff next`. The CLI write keeps the `handoff new` body (handoff.mjs:40), and five quick batons, including landed a7 and review-land-fixes-012, kept that placeholder. The frontmatter summary and D3-D6 record what changed, the acceptance evidence and the publication boundary.
